issuer.description: Account uid that issued the capability.

delegate.description: Account uid the capability is delegated to.

account.description: Account uid the capability grants access to.

path.description: Path within the account the capability grants access to; empty for the root.

role.description: Role granted to the delegate, as the proto enum name such as `WRITER` or `AGENT`.

noRecursive.description: When `true`, the capability applies only to the exact path, not its subpaths.

label.description: Short, user-provided label identifying the capability.

createTime.description: Time the capability was issued, as an RFC 3339 string.

description: A capability as the daemon indexes it, in raw wire form where every field is optional.
